Candidates must apply online through the concerned Website of the OPSC http://opsc.gov.in.
Upload scanned image of latest passport size photograph along with scanned image of full signature and Left-hand Thumb Impression (LTI).
Submit the Online Application Form well in advance without waiting for the closing date.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for OPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 26 November 2026. Applications opened on 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in OPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 89 vacancies: 7 Physics, 6 Ballistics, 10 Chemistry, 13 Toxicology, 14 Biology, 4 Serology and 4 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for OPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates other than SC, ST, and PwD category: Rs. 700.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is must have attained the age of 21 years and must not be above the age of 42 years on the 1st day of January, 2026 (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: SEBC/SC/ST/Women/Ex-Servicemen 5, PwD 10.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 44,900 for Physics, Rs. 44,900 for Ballistics, Rs. 44,900 for Chemistry, Rs. 44,900 for Toxicology, Rs. 44,900 for Biology.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Graduate or Master's Degree in relevant discipline with minimum 55% marks. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be able to speak, read and write Odia and have passed M.E. School or higher examination with Odia as a language subject or equivalent. Must be a citizen of India.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates with temporary disability for PwD category. Married candidates having more than one spouse living, unless exempted.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written Examination. Personality Test / Viva Voce. Written Examination consisting of Paper-I (100 marks) and Paper-II (300 marks). Personality Test / Viva Voce carrying 50 marks.
